summary: Verified BAKED Global Search end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 primary + 9/9 extra regression tests pass (22/22). FOOD regression tests (test_food_orders, test_food_search, test_food_partner_menu, test_food_dispatch_bridge) remain green. Contract shape, cross-module hits (coca cola MART, pizza FOOD, milk FOOD+MART, dress/shoes SHOP), intents (send_parcel/book_truck/shift_home/book_table FR+EN with locale-correct action_labels), normalization (accent + punctuation + hyphen tolerant), module filter, short-circuit (q<2), click endpoint fire-and-forget, event_id emission all confirmed on preview URL. Frontend: desktop typeahead (coca cola, pizza stale-request handling, envoyer-un-colis intent), results page (/search?q=...), tabs, module query sync, FR-only empty state, intent routing to /send/book/parcel, and backward compat all work. Two frontend issues found: (1) MAJOR mobile — the `top-nav-search-input-mobile` chevron is never rendered because `MobileHeader` replaces `TopNav` below md, and its `m-header-search` button navigates to `/products` instead of `/search`, so mobile users bypass global search entirely; (2) MINOR — `/products?search=foo` is silently redirected to the French-slug `/produits?search=foo` by the locale router (page renders correctly with results, but user asked for 'do NOT redirect').

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile global-search entrypoint missing. `data-testid='top-nav-search-input-mobile'` chevron (defined in TopNav.jsx with md:hidden) is never rendered on mobile because MobileShell swaps TopNav for MobileHeader. MobileHeader's `m-header-search` button navigates to `/products` (legacy MART search) or `/shop/categories`, NOT to `/search`. Global search is therefore unreachable from the mobile header.

integration_issues.issue: URL redirects to French slug /produits?search=foo. Results render correctly (MART page shows 2 Riz items for q=riz) but spec said 'do NOT redirect'. Likely locale-slug middleware. Minor.

action_items: Fix MobileHeader: either rename & re-wire `m-header-search` to navigate to `/search` and expose `data-testid='top-nav-search-input-mobile'` (dual testid), or replace MobileHeader's search button with a shared chevron that routes to /search. Current behaviour makes global search unreachable from the mobile header.
Decide on backward-compat redirect for /products?search=foo. If intended, update the spec/comment; if not, exempt /products from the locale slug redirect so the URL stays as /products?search=foo.
critical_code_review_comments: GlobalSearchHeaderBox portal pattern + outside-click detection correctly accounts for the portal via document.querySelector of dropdown testid — good.

search response groups are a list (not a dict keyed by module) — confirm this is the stabilised contract; the request spec described keyed groups. All 13 existing tests expect the list shape so this is consistent, but update docs if needed.

Mobile UX: MobileHeader bypasses the newly added global search feature; consider centralising header search behind a single component rather than duplicating button logic across TopNav + MobileHeader.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing seeded intents and catalogs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 22/22 search backend tests pass. The only remaining frontend gap is the mobile entrypoint: `top-nav-search-input-mobile` is defined on TopNav with md:hidden, but TopNav itself is swapped out by MobileShell on <md viewports, so the chevron never mounts. Mobile users land on the old /products MART search via `m-header-search` instead of /search. Also `/products?search=` 302-redirects to `/produits?search=` (locale slug) but the MART page still renders correctly.
